_comment: TWO configurations, for two different purposes.
1. 'Tech Aim manuals (generated HTML)' - PREVIEWABLE. Serves the
generated manual HTML over HTTP so it can be opened in the browser
pane. Generate the output first:
powershell -File docs\manual\build-manuals.ps1 -Format html
2. 'TechAim.exe (desktop launch)' - NOT PREVIEWABLE. Tech Aim is a Qt
Widgets/QML DESKTOP application: it opens its own window and serves
no HTTP, so a browser preview pane has nothing to show. This entry
exists so the launch/debug command is recorded in one place; run it
from a terminal, not through preview_start.
It launches an ALREADY-BUILT binary and does not build. Build first:
qmake Seta.pro
mingw32-make -f Makefile.Release -j4
with Qt 6.5.3 MinGW on PATH:
C:/Qt/6.5.3/mingw_64/bin and C:/Qt/Tools/mingw1120_64/bin
After QML edits force a qrc regen: rm -f release/qrc_qml.cpp release/qrc_qml.o
For diagnostics run it with QT_FORCE_STDERR_LOGGING=1 and read stderr.
Operating mode and language come from release/config.ini
([App_Settings] app_mode / ui_language). config.ini is untracked.
HISTORY: the original single entry could never start (spawn qmake
ENOENT). It spawned 'qmake', which is not on the spawned process PATH;
passed -spec win32-msvc and nmake although this project builds with
MinGW; and launched release/Seta.exe, renamed to TechAim.exe in P0.
